newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee futures forge ahead, funds seen.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee futures forge ahead, funds seen.

text.p: London robusta coffee futures forged ahead to end Tuesday sharply up on broad-based buying led by the funds and inspired by fresh New York's rally and the strengthening of structure in robusta.
Traders said initial hedge selling by Vietnam was well absorbed by the market and this paved the way for further upside movement as New York arabica futures propelled higher from the start.
London's active May picked up some steam in the afternoon, rising to a peak of $1,699 a tonne but failed to clear the psychological $1,700 mark. The contract still finished $46 firmer at $1,698.
Traders noted brisk outright and switch buying by the industry, trade and the funds. The funds also extended their interest further into forward July, which gained $48 at $1,700.
March/May spread ended at $7 after trading at level money to $5 over in the morning.
Overall volume totalled 7,290 lots. The options pit was less brisk, with some 700 lots mainly in May $1,700 calls, changing hands.
New York's March contract broke through the $2.00 mark, pushing its way to a $2.12 ceiling, while May also surged to a high of $1.97 in morning business.
Traders said the surge was powered by industry price-fixing. This met with little origin offers.
"The origins have sold out in New York," said one.

The New York market had been leading the rally in coffee since the start of the year. The U.S. market had risen by more than 50 percent as arabica supplies from South and Central America are extremely tight.
Technically, London's May faces an upside hurdle at $1,720, the last highs seen on February 13.
There were no new market-moving factors but traders noted comments by German roaster J.J. Darboven that there would be no supply tightness this year.
"We assume that 1996/97 production will be enough to meet demand, said Guenther Fude, the company's head of raw materials purchasing. -- Jalil Hamid, London newsroom +44 171 542 4985
